comment: Independent C-first continuation of the frozen 511-turn timer setup. Source `wiz_intrinsic` accepts an explicit duration before each menu item; this route grants 1000 turns of Flying, blindness (so sighted-monster proximity does not interrupt the timed wait), and invulnerability (to survive any adjacent monster), then wishes melting ice and uses one bounded 511-turn wait. C output will be inspected before any JS comparison. The hero remains on the ice square throughout so the timer callback can take the `u_at`/`spoteffects` path.
